definitions.short: Pashchur , the name of four Israelites
definitions.full: H6583. Pashchur מַּשְׁחוּר proper name, masculine Πασχωρ , Φα ( δα ) σσουρ etc.: 1 Jer 20:1-2 , 3 (twice in verse); 20:6 . 2 Jer 21:1 ; 38:1 b Neh 11:12 , compare 1Chr 9:12 . 3 Neh 10:4 . 4 father of one Gedaliah Jer 38:1 a. 5 head of post-exile family Ezra 2:38 = Neh 7:14 ; Ezra 10:22 . compare Mey Entstehung 169 f .
